Method of Attack: Exploits multiple SharePoint vulnerabilities including zero-day CVE-2025-53770 and older CVEs CVE-2025-49706 and CVE-2025-49704 to create backdoors, steal system keys, enable authentication bypass and code injection, leading to remote machine takeover
Impacted Systems: On-premises SharePoint servers including SharePoint Subscription Edition, SharePoint 2019, SharePoint 2016
Attack Vector: Exploitation of SharePoint software vulnerabilities via public-facing on-premises SharePoint servers exposed to the internet
Indicators of Compromise: Shell planted at same filepath leaking sensitive key material
Multiple compromised servers detected with identical payloads
Detection of compromises on over 8,000 public-facing SharePoint environments
